answer_1.quote: We employ LLaMA-3-70B to generate correct evidence and misinformation texts based on corresponding claims with entity descriptions.

answer_2.quote: We utilize Natural Language Inference (NLI) to determine the semantic relationship between the origin claim and the corresponding correct evidence.

answer_4.quote: We employ three annotators and they were tasked with manually checking whether the generated misinformation logically supports the claims and whether it contradicts the correct evidence.
answer_4.guideline: Entailment Check: Determining whether the generated misinformation logically supports the corresponding claim. Conflict Check: Determining whether the generated factual, temporal and semantic misinformation contradict with the correct evidence text.
